flags.name: Xenon Pharmaceuticals
flags.summary: Fell about 29% after pausing its Phase 3 epilepsy drug trial - a severe, unambiguous catalyst. Technicals confirm the weakness: a 'Strong Sell' rating with 11 of 12 moving averages bearish and a deeply oversold Stochastic RSI (16.3), though the 14-day RSI (36.9) isn't extreme yet. Watch for further downside risk rather than an immediate bounce.
flags.historical_context: General technical-analysis experience: large single-day drops from clinical-trial setbacks in biotech names have tended to see continued weakness or extended sideways consolidation over the following days-to-weeks rather than a quick V-shaped recovery, since the market typically waits for the company's next update (revised guidance, trial restart plans) before a bottom forms. An oversold reading alone doesn't reliably mark a bottom when the catalyst is this severe - this is a general tendency, not a prediction for this specific stock.

flags.name: Coinbase Global
flags.summary: Jumped about 6.6% after the SEC approved a five-year 'Innovation Exemption' allowing tokenized stock trading - a real regulatory tailwind, not routine noise. Technicals confirm strong momentum (Strong Buy rating, MACD +5.23, ADX 54.8), but the 14-day RSI is already at 71 (overbought), so this is a watch-for-further-upside setup with real near-term pullback risk after the pop.
flags.historical_context: General technical-analysis experience: momentum breakouts backed by a genuine catalyst and confirming volume/trend strength (like a rising ADX) have tended to keep running for a stretch, but RSI readings above 70 also raise the odds of a short-term pullback or consolidation before any further advance - chasing right after a 6%+ single-day pop has historically carried elevated mean-reversion risk. This is a general tendency, not a prediction for this specific stock.
